test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about NITI Aayog is INCORRECT?

options.text: It works as a premier think tank of the government of India.
It is a platform for cooperation federalism.
NITI stands for National Institution for Transforming India

solution:
The correct answer is__** It was established on 1 January 2016. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• NITI Aayog was formed via a resolution of the Union Cabinet on** 1 January 2015.**
 
• NITI Aayog replaced the **Planning Commission of India**.
 
• It is generally a** think-tank or an advisory body.**
 
• The Planning Commission designed Five Years Plans in India.
 
• NITI Aayog gives to-the-point advice to the** center and state governments as well as to the Union territories.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05b3872c3f41ffa412b16b90c4b616dddb2d9d194dc9d776de080e34f66d58d0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog was established with the motive to **achieve Sustainable Development Goals and to increase cooperative federalism.****​ **
 
• NITI AAYOG **stands for NATIONAL INSTITUTION FOR TRANSFORMING INDIA**. 
 
• **Mr. Parameswaran Iyer** is the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog.
